text:
maria: heads up — after last night's SCIM schema shift we still have ~30 principals with org-admin bindings that should've been removed. Noticed during an audit export.
jack: which provisioner handled those groups? hosted-provisioner or the new scim-provisioner-v2?
maria: scim-provisioner-v2. The change renamed the admin attribute in AD -> 'admin_flag' and AD is now sending role: null for some groups. The deprovision matcher looked for is_admin explicitly so it never queued deletes.
eli: ah that mismatch would silently skip removal. can you paste the relevant provisioning log lines?
maria: pasted a couple snippets below — provisioner returned 200 but payload didn't include delete actions.
```
[2026-03-19T23:45:12Z] POST /provision/events -> {"type":"GroupPatch","groupId":"grp-9f3","changes":[{"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"svc-123","display":"svc-app"}]}]} -> 200 OK
[2026-03-19T23:45:12Z] reconcile: matched group schema 'scim_v2_v1_compat' -> matcher=has_attr("is_admin") -> not matched -> no removal queued
```
sasha: that explains KMS grants still present — the binding removal path also revokes key grants. I can see a grant record: `kms:GrantGrantId=gg-77,Principal=svc-123,Key=projects/redwood/keys/infra-key,PolicyAttachment=role:org-admin`
jack: great catch. so cause = schema rename + matcher logic. impact = stale admin bindings + lingering KMS grants. severity = P2 (compliance exposure until we remove bindings).
henry: we need an auditable remediation: (1) fix matcher in provisioner, (2) run a controlled reconcile dry-run, export the list, (3) get approvals, (4) run apply and capture audit entries + KMS revoke jobs.
maria: running dry-run now: `./scripts/scim-reconcile --since "2026-03-19T00:00:00Z" --detect-stale-admins --dry-run > /tmp/stale-admins-2265432100.json`
provisioner-bot: Reconcile job queued (jobId: r-2265).
provisioner-bot: Reconcile job started. scanning groups changed since 2026-03-19T00:00:00Z
provisioner-bot: Reconcile job finished: 29 stale bindings detected, 0 applied (dry-run). report: /tmp/stale-admins-2265432100.json
sasha: added a quick grep on KMS logs to map principals to grants: `gcloud kms keys list-grants --key infra-key | grep svc-` — got 27 matches overlapping the reconcile list.
jack: I'm opening a PR to update the matcher to check both legacy and new attributes (is_admin OR admin_flag) + unit tests that simulate null role payloads. will tag infra for canary. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/provisioner/+/4321
maria: after jack's canary passes, I'll run reconcile with --apply but only on a small subset: `--filter=org:internal --limit=50` first. I'll also capture the post-change audit bundle (audit-log + kms-revoke records) and upload to the compliance ticket.
henry: add a mitigation note for Support: run `./tools/quick-remove --principal svc-123 --confirm` if there's an immediate high-risk principal; otherwise follow the staged reconcile.
jack: will also add a safety check to avoid revoking grants for principals that have service-owner role in other tenants (edge case).
maria: putting a short incident summary in #incidents and creating a compliance ticket: INC-2026-089. tagging @compliance.
sasha: reacted with :eyes:
henry: reacted with :thumbsup:
provisioner-bot: Audit snapshot created: s3://redwood-audit/incoming/stale-admins-2265432100.json (size: 18kb)
maria: next steps: (1) jack deploys matcher fix canary (ETA 2h), (2) dry-run reconcile validated (done), (3) compliance signoff for apply (ETA 4h after canary), (4) run apply with kms revoke worker and collect audit bundle. I'll post updates here.
jack: noted — PR merged to canary branch. trigger deploy.
maria: running apply once canary is green. will paste final audit bundle here when done.
